# Henrix Band

> Henrix Band is a Latvian live cover band for weddings, private parties, jubilees and corporate events — company balls, year-end and Christmas parties, client evenings — across Latvia. Line-ups of 3–5 musicians, a standard 3 × 50 min programme, Latvian and international hits. Prices on request. Site in Latvian (https://henrix.lv/) and English (https://henrix.lv/en/); enquiries answered in Latvian or English.

## Line-ups
- Henrix Essential — 3 musicians. Compact format for wedding dinners, private celebrations, jubilees, receptions and smaller corporate events.
- Henrix Live+ — 4 musicians. The most versatile line-up: weddings, jubilees, private parties, company balls, Christmas and year-end parties, mid-size events.
- Henrix Full Experience — 5 musicians (vocals / acoustic guitar, electric guitar, bass, keys, drums). Full concert-party experience for large weddings, balls and celebrations.

## Programme
- Standard: 3 × 50 minute sets; can be split into 4 shorter sets around dinner, host programme, awards, performances or DJ.

## Included
- Band in the chosen line-up, 3 × 50 min programme, programme adapted to the event schedule, instruments and technical equipment, sound for the agreed format, transport within Riga, setup and soundcheck, repertoire adapted to the audience.
- Events outside Riga: the band plays all over Latvia; travel costs may be added to the quote.

## Repertoire
- 70+ songs in Latvian, English, Spanish and Portuguese. Examples: Can't Stop The Feeling, September, 24K Magic, Celebration, It's My Life, Simply The Best, Yellow; Latvian: Laternas (Sudden Lights), Ogles (Prāta Vētra), Pa ceļam (Dons), Vējā (Fēlikss Ķiģelis).

## Henrix Alternative
- Henrix Alternative is Henrix Band's alternative music programme: mainly 90s and 00s alternative rock, plus some newer songs and well-known classics, played live by 4 musicians from Henrix Band. Page in Latvian: https://henrix.lv/alternative/ and English: https://henrix.lv/en/alternative/
- For company parties, private parties and birthdays, clubs and bars, festivals. Artists in the set include Blur, Limp Bizkit, Green Day, Placebo, Bon Jovi, Foo Fighters, Måneskin, The White Stripes, The Offspring, Nickelback; full song list sent with the offer. Price on request.
- Booking form: https://henrix.lv/alternative/#rezervet (Latvian), https://henrix.lv/en/alternative/#rezervet (English)
